observations: Both light captures initially had capture failures (closed drawer / wrong height). Those files were recaptured and the final 8 files were visually inspected again.
DELL has 4 failed condition names, STNG has 3; no conditional-row missing condition is hidden behind the optional calculation-detail disclosure.
The 2026-09-29 calendar is expired at the actual current clock, and its failure includes the explicit 2026-10-01 05:00 JST expiry. No condition was promoted to pass for the screenshots.
The two lower captures establish STNG condition readability; not all final cash totals are visible in every individual crop, so no one-viewport completeness claim is made.
These are internal visual scores, not a survey, award certification, or 100-user satisfaction result.
